name: School of Fantasia
original_name: スクールオブファンタジア
source:
This harem RPG is the professional debut for doujin circle Tamamo Studio, under the name Tamamo Soft. 

All of a sudden, there were children who were born in Japan with special abilities. They were segregated to a school located on Tendoujima, an island in the southern sea. Meanwhile, the relatively normal Yorito drifted on to the island after being swept by the waves from his adventurer father’s raft. After Himeno saved his life with artificial respiration, he ended up transferring into the Tendoujima Gakuen. Since he was suspected of being a spy, he accepted a request to explore the dungeon where monsters dwelled in order to establish his innocence. He enjoyed a pleasant life with the girls at the school, getting to know them better and solving their worries, but soon he became involved in various events while investigating the dungeon.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/01/05/january-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
這部後宮RPG是同人社團Tamamo Studio以Tamamo Soft名義推出的商業處女作。

某天，日本突然出現了一批擁有特殊能力的孩子。他們被集中到南海的天道島，在島上的學校裡生活。與此同時，相對普通的寄人被冒險家父親的木筏捲走，漂流到這座島上。希梅諾透過人工呼吸救了他的命，寄人因此轉入天道島學園。由於被懷疑是間諜，他接受了委託，前往怪物出沒的地城探索，以證明自己的清白。他在學校裡和女孩們一起度過愉快的日子，逐漸瞭解她們並解決煩惱；然而，在調查地城的過程中，他很快捲入了各種事件。

[來源：[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/01/05/january-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
